Prevention: If not using certified seed, put seed in 50 degrees
Celcius water for 15-20 minutes before planting
Graft with wild rootstock of eggplant
Use plastic mulch to prevent soil from splashing and spreading
Don’t over water or over fertilize with
N Clean equipment (including shoes) before use in the field
Limit unauthorized people and animals from entering the farm to prevent spread of disease
Consider using soil-less substrate (eg hydroponics, or grow in cocoa peat in pots.
Rotate tomatoes with non solanaceous crops for three years to help in reducing the bacterial inoculum to non-damaging levels
Monitoring: Scout plant for signs of wilting
Direct Control: During season remove diseased plants from the field and destroy
